annotations.title: Add a document to a case

description: Use this when the person asks you to add a document to a draft case: the lease, the tenant ledger, emails or messages with the tenant, proof that they own or manage the property, or a notice already served and its proof of service. Input: the case `id`, `filename`, `purpose` and `contentBase64` (a PDF, JPEG or PNG of about 700 KB at most through this server; a file up to 4 MB goes through `POST /v1/cases/{id}/documents` with the person’s key). Adds the document to the case; each call adds one more, but a repeat with the same `idempotencyKey` is safe (it returns the first answer). Works on a draft; after a live case is submitted, only a document with the purpose `other` can be added. Returns the document as stored. Do not use this when no case exists yet (use evictions_send_intake_file) or to change the case’s facts (use evictions_update_case). Next: evictions_validate_case. Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

contentBase64.description: The file itself, base64-encoded: a PDF, JPEG or PNG of about 700 KB at most (950,000 base64 characters). A larger file, up to 4 MB, goes through the API directly.

filename.description: The file’s name, such as lease.pdf. Its type is read from the file itself, not from the name.

id.description: The case id (case_...), as returned by evictions_create_case or evictions_list_cases.

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header (printable ASCII, no spaces): a repeat of the same request with the same key returns the first answer instead of the document added twice. Always pass one, and reuse it if you repeat the call.

purpose.description: What the document is: the lease, the tenant ledger, correspondence (emails or messages with the tenant), authority (proof the person owns or manages the property), prior_notice (a notice already served), prior_notice_proof (proof that notice was served), or other.

name: evictions_add_case_document
title: Add a document to a case
